verdict.rationale: Stripe documents Restricted API Keys (RAKs) as the recommended, permission-scoped credential type specifically for AI agents, letting developers limit exactly what actions/resources an agent can access, plus SPTs that scope agent payment access with currency/amount/expiration limits and revocability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of RAK scoping granularity in practice and any reported friction/limitations from real-world agent deployments.
